title: Shuck It | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Shuck It — a condominium in Seacrest, Florida. 6 guests · 2 bedrooms · 2 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Shuck It' your dreamy Gulf-front escape where laid-back coastal charm meets elevated beachfront luxury! Perfectly positioned right on the shoreline, this stunning retreat offers breathtaking sea views and direct access to the sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf. From sunrise coffee on the balcony to unforgettable sunset evenings with the sound of the waves in the background, every moment at Shuck It is designed for pure relaxation and effortless coastal living.Inside, you’ll find a beautifully designed space filled with light, comfort, and modern beach-inspired style. The spacious primary suite features a king bed, creating the perfect private retreat after a day in the sun. The guest bedroom is ideal for families or friends, offering a king bed along with charming built-in twin beds that make the space both fun and functional. Thoughtfully curated décor, cozy furnishings, and upscale finishes throughout the home create a welcoming atmosphere that instantly feels like vacation.Spend your days soaking up the sunshine, walking the shoreline, or exploring the coast with the 2 complimentary bikes included with your stay. Whether you're cruising to nearby shops and restaurants, enjoying lazy beach days, or simply relaxing while watching the waves roll in, Shuck It offers the perfect blend of adventure and tranquility.With unbeatable Gulf-front views, stylish accommodations, and all the comforts of home, Shuck It is more than just a vacation rental it’s the coastal getaway you’ll want to return to year after year!HOME HIGHLIGHTSGulf FrontPrivate Beach Access2 Adult BikesPatio with SeatingSmart TVsFully Stocked KitchenFull Washer DryerBeach Gear1 Dedicated Parking SpotACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 62 Bedrooms / 2 BathsFIRST FLOORMaster Bedroom: King Bed with Private BathGuest Bedroom: (2) Built-In Over Head Twin Bed + King Bed, Shared BathWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee GroundsCoffee Filters2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGThere is 1 dedicated parking spot directly in front of the unit with overflow available on a first come first serve basis.Included are 2 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.SEACREST COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSSeacrest is casually upscale, making it easy for guests to find endless relaxation. Turn off your phone and forget about your emails as you explore all that Seacrest has to offer. The area s legendary sugar-white sand and turquoise water are only part of what makes Seacrest a true getaway. Grab a bite to eat and a cup of coffee at Seacrest Sundries, the local grocery store, before spending the day wandering through Seacrest s shops and riding bikes along the Timpoochee Trail.BEACH ACCESSEnjoy private deeded beach access just past the green space toward the back of the home. Big Fish Bike and Beach Rentals is the exclusive provider at your private beach access.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*Capacity for 1 vehicle in the parking lot. Additional parking on north end at a first come first serve basis.*Home must remain pet free.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a selfie.Other things to note
